comments: f4ea2574: ;Call the DE (Data Entry) input validation routine and go to the BEGIN label.

c0fb931a: ;Set variables for the Data Entry routine: DIE is the global root, DIC is the file number, DP is the primary file number, DL is the level of the record being edited, DIEL is a flag indicating if editing at a lower level. Check if there are any existing multiple records and quit if not.
30d9f9c1: ;If there is a date/time stamp in the record, store it in the DE(1) variable.
e811c815: ;Kill the %Z variable used for date/time storage and quit.
287f833f: ;Write a prompt for the field being edited, including the field label and number.
ca75a0a0: ;Quit after writing the field prompt.
ab54cbda: ;Output the response to the field. If the response wraps to the next line, indent it.

ad4a2bc2: ;If the response is longer than 19 characters, the field is not a word-processing field, and the field is either free text or a set of codes, branch to the RW^DIR2 routine to handle the input.

cf6a4b77: ;If there is a response and the field is not word-processing and is a set of codes, write a double slash before the response. If the field is a set of codes and has a default value, write '(No Editing)' if there is no user response.
a7c0343c: ;Read the user's response into X, with a timeout determined by DTIME. If the user times out, set DTOUT=U (undefined) and X=U, and write a bell character.
90f1769b: ;Quit after reading the user's response.
78d64664: Initialize $ORDER value and increment
ac479649: Branch to next label based on $ORDER
a5edde5c: Re-entry point; if DE array element exists, branch to PR, else execute W and TR
071d0735: If X is null and DV doesn't contain 'R', go to A; if X is null and DV exists, go to X; if X is null and internal value is negative, go to X; else go to A
6febe754: If X starts with '?', branch to QS; if X contains '^', execute D and branch to ^DIE17
ecc1bc63: If X is '@', execute D and branch to Z^DIE2
7e2f18b0: If X is ' ', DV contains 'd' and doesn't contain 'P', and DUZ has a DIE array element for the current block, set X to that value; if DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S', write '  ' followed by X

dc574dfd: If DV exists, branch to M^DIE17; if DV contains 'V', branch to ^DIE3; if DV doesn't contain 'S', branch to P; execute code from DD global if it exists; set % to match of X in DU separated by ';'; set Y to X; if % isn't null, execute DIC('S') if it exists; if DB(DQ) doesn't exist, write '  ' followed by %; go to V

3bfc55d3: Loop through DU separated by ';'; set Y to each piece; set DG to position of ':' followed by X in Y; if Y is null, go to X; set YS to Y; set Y to piece before ':' in Y; if DG exists, execute DIC('S') if it exists; if DG exists, quit loop
968d7f9f: If DB(DQ) doesn't exist, write substring of YS from DG to the end; set X to piece of YS before ':'
667996c0: ;Exit if the user enters an up-arrow or the entry is deleted.
d5f5a2d3: ;If this is not a word-processing field and the length of the decimal portion exceeds 24 digits, clear the input and quit.
c34db6df: ;If precision is specified for a non-computed numeric field, remove leading and trailing zeroes.
e17533cf: ;Restore X and kill control variables.
7d63ff0c: ;Store the data value, set audit trail if editing existing data.
61792b34: ;If data is in ^DD, branch to label Z^DIE17.
3509a93d: ;Set X to a Bad Data code.
a78d66bc: ;Store X in DZ, call D and QQ^DIEQ, and branch to label B.
ea6bd9b2: ;Set D to DIFLD, store field definition nodes in DQ array, and quit.
d267fc1b: ;If no INPUT transform, branch to RD if not @data; if this input, execute INPUT transform if present; else set X=Y and fall through to N.
78148c73: ;If a POINTER field with UNEDITABLE:'DG=DV, Y=DE(DQ), X=DU. If DQ(DQ,2) exists, execute it and branch to RP.

d0e71795: ;For POINTER field: if DG=P and FILE entry exists, set X to IEN; else set Y=0 and DG=0;R. For a VARIABLE POINTER: If DG=V and Y is a IEN, if semi-colon piece 2 of Y is parenthesized, and the global node exists, set X to IEN. Fall through to RP if file entry doesn't exist, else set Y to value, and if DD(.01) node exists, update DG and X from it
55e04229: ;If DG=D, execute INPUT transform; if DG=S, set Y to externalized Y (if any).
f7eddded: ;For SET/KILL x of a subfield UPDATE DATA x^DD("DD") is executed.
3c3b79a2: ;Reads external value into X, quits if refused with '^', or goes to A label if null data or computed field.
dc27b1aa: ;If not a help frame or MUMPS cross reference, branches to the RD (read) label.
18a3cd49: ;Calls code for computed fields, branches to RD on success or PR if failed.
56833d36: ;Ends input if unable to resolve computed field.
16335eb9: ;Initializes variables for DGJXA9 field (#1) in file.
7235a8d2: ;Sets field properties and prompts for DATE DICTATED field (#10.01).
f1dddace: ;Branches to the field reader routine.
9b94ad4e: ;Prompts for a date, removing time component, and allows entry backdating.
01286541: ;Ends input.
